review.rationale: Option A correctly identifies the macOS /tmp vs /private/tmp alias as the root cause and replaces fragile absolute-path CWD equality with a sound, minimal, fail-closed Git-context contract: exact HEAD/remote equality, exact git rev-parse --show-prefix (digital-biosphere-architecture/), exact frozen patch SHA-256 (40319c6101bff7da943c230591a5222e6ac107b5ca0d15c598be652af41b4dec), and exact five-path relative set via git diff --relative --name-only --. The immutable R3 failure is explicitly preserved (no reclassification to PASS), repository identity is bound by Git primitives rather than ephemeral temp paths, and all non-authorizations (no commit/push/repair/rollback/deploy/network/authority/evidence changes) remain complete and consistent with the R3 record. Caps and stop rules enforce single-run, fail-closed execution with zero retries/fallbacks. Options B-D are correctly rejected for broadening or removing context guarantees.
